blocks.text: Anthony Pangilinan spoke up about Showtime Baby Doll Juby’s “dream” about his actor son Donny Pangilinan, saying that her statement could have been handled with more sensitivity. Juby and her fellow members made a guest appearance on “Gandang Gabi, Vice” last Oct. 18, where she shared a dream she had that supposedly involved a sexual encounter with Pangilinan. The topic came up after show host Vice Ganda asked the girl group members their respective celebrity crushes.
